insight.headline: Taxes Recalculated
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated on an unfulfilled order. This change affects orders updated through the GraphQL Admin API. Previously, taxes were not recalculated after updating the shipping address.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the orderUpdate mutation should be aware that taxes will now be recalculated when the shipping address is updated. This may impact the total cost of the order and any subsequent fulfillment or payment processing. Developers should review their code to ensure it handles the updated tax calculations correctly. The GraphQL Admin API will return the updated tax amounts in the order response.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see accurate tax calculations for orders with updated shipping addresses, ensuring compliance with tax regulations and avoiding potential disputes with customers.
insight.why_it_matters: Accurate tax calculations are crucial for merchants to comply with tax regulations and avoid financial losses. This change ensures that taxes are recalculated correctly when the shipping address is updated, providing a better experience for merchants and customers.
